cohorts.selection: Participants asked for their most important five to seven chats; donated range five to twenty-one chats.
All exported chats; small self-selected sample.

observations.scope: De-identified message metadata. Young sample (reported median age 25.5); donated timespans differ. Separate medians do not determine the distribution of individual message rates. No joint population distribution or full-message byte-size distribution is established.

observations.location: Data and Methods; Effects on Data Received
observations.scope: Actual Facebook/Instagram download-package study supports sensitivity to retained timespan and platform-specific truncation. Package MB sizes are not used to calibrate this metadata-only RDF corpus because their binary/content boundary differs or is unclear.

sensitivity.other_parameters: Identical to service-history-central-v2, including seeded volume classes and effective rights.
sensitivity.interpretation: A declared higher-volume sensitivity motivated by observed retained-message stocks, not a fitted empirical distribution, inferred mean message rate, or validated all-service population model. Central-v2 and the completed pilot are unchanged.
